description: Test prompts that verify rdk-board-delegate triggers and produces correct S-series heterogeneous-development guidance. Prompts are written the way a real RDK robotics developer would phrase them (Chinese). Run with-skill vs baseline and grade the assertions.

evals.name: mcu1-wfi-crash
evals.prompt: 我在 S100 上重新编了 MCU 固件，echo stop 之后马上 echo start，板子直接跑飞挂死了，为什么？
evals.expected_output: Identifies the wfi trap: after stop you must wait for the system to enter wfi mode before start; restarting too early overwrites running code in MCU SRAM.

assertions.text: Explains that after echo stop you must wait for the system to enter wfi mode before echo start again.
Explains why: an early start reloads firmware into MCU SRAM and overwrites the running code, crashing the board.
Notes MCU1 loads via remoteproc (sysfs state node), not JTAG/flashing, and you cannot power-cycle MCU1 alone.

evals.name: s600-ethercat-native
evals.prompt: S600 上要做多轴伺服运动控制，EtherCAT 主站怎么起？跟 S100 一样吗？
evals.expected_output: S600 V5.1.0+ defaults to the Native (ec_hobot) EtherCAT driver, mutually exclusive with hobot_eth_super, MAC-based config; start via ethercat.service.

assertions.text: States S600 is covered and V5.1.0+ defaults to the Native (hobot/ec_hobot) EtherCAT driver.
Notes the Native driver is mutually exclusive with the gmac/hobot_eth_super driver and the bound port's MAC disappears from ip a (config uses the MAC address).
Mentions starting via ethercat.service and checking status with 'ethercat master', and/or pairing with PTP and IPC core-pinning for determinism.

evals.name: hbmem-zero-copy
evals.prompt: 相机出来的图要送进 BPU 推理，怎么避免拷贝大块内存？S100 上有什么机制？
evals.expected_output: Use hbmem zero-copy shared memory (libhbmem), import buffers with consume-count, graph_buf for images; APIs need root; don't mmap raw physical addresses.

assertions.text: Recommends hbmem / libhbmem zero-copy shared memory and the import + consume-count mechanism.
Mentions graph_buf for images vs com_buf for featuremaps, and/or that hbmem APIs require root.
Warns against mmap-ing a raw physical address because it does not bump the reference count.

evals.name: delegate-handoff-fields
evals.prompt: 我要把一个 MCU 排查任务委派给板端 OpenClaw agent，应该写哪些信息它才不会把我打回？
evals.expected_output: Lists the five required handoff fields: goal, background, done-so-far (with real output), analysis, expectation.

assertions.text: Lists the required handoff fields: goal, background, done-so-far, analysis, expectation (all five).
Says background must include board (S100/S100P/S600), debug/release, and current state (offline/running).
Says done-so-far must include the actual command output, not just a description.

evals.name: miniboot-no-rollback
evals.prompt: 我只想单独升级 S600 的 miniboot/bootloader，不想整片重烧，可以吗？有什么风险？
evals.expected_output: Yes via rdk-miniboot-update; only touches BAK+AB miniboot partitions, applies on reboot, cannot upgrade the partition table; no auto-rollback so a failed write can brick boot.

assertions.text: Says yes — use rdk-miniboot-update (from hobot-miniboot), works on non-OTA images and applies on reboot.
Notes it only updates the miniboot BAK/AB partitions and cannot upgrade the partition table.
Warns there is no built-in auto-rollback, so a failed dd or power loss mid-write can leave the device unbootable.
